The options may be chosen on the product page Archer Knobs $ 4.99 Inspired by the Pros, Loved by All Now this pedal, so far, is magical. It’s exactly what I was looking for. I figured the best way to find a new pedal is to look up what guitarist you love are using. I’m basically obsessed with Snarky Puppy, and found a gear rundown from a couple of the members. Mark Lettieri talked about his board, including this pedal, which he made with J. Rockett audio designs! RockinJosh The J. Rockett Rockaway Archer. This is brilliant, and now I’m wondering why not all overdrives have a 6-band graphic EQ. This thing is absolutely brilliant. It’s still definitely an Archer at heart (which is a Klon type pedal), but the 6-band graphic EQ gives it an insane amount of versatility for tone shaping.
